-- View 1: Monthly Revenue
CREATE VIEW vw_monthly_revenue AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'gold/monthly_revenue/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'nyc_tlc_storage',
    FORMAT = 'DELTA'
) AS result;
